mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are clear near Badger Ridge Middle School under a full moon, with a temperature of 57 degrees and an air quality index of 51. Overnight, expect the temperature to drop to 49 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

City officials have announced that a section of Hwy M near the new Aldi site will be closed for construction from October 5 to October 7, so please plan for detours using Old PB and Main Street. Additionally, please remember the City of Verona only accepts fee payments by check, not through online wire transfers or credit cards.
There is plenty to do, including the Verona Fall Fest and live music at Bailey's Run both happening today, plus the Dane County Farmer's Market on the Square tomorrow.
Regarding local safety, on September 10, officers responded to a burglary at Hunters Cove Way where an offender was apprehended after a shot was fired during the incident.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel, but they will be back with the Oreo Reese's Cheesecake flavor of the day when they open tomorrow at 10:00 AM.
